entry.name: live.step
entry.description: live.step displays multiple sequences which have multiple steps composed of pitch, velocity, and duration. Two additional steps (Extra 1 and Extra 2) are available for user-defined display.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Report mouse activity
messages.description: Whenever theobject is edited using the mouse, the messagefollowed by a number in the range 0-2 will be sent out the object's dumpout outlet. The number specifies what portion of thedisplay has been modified, as follows:0: The pitch, velocity, duration, extra1, or extra2 settings have been modified.1: The looping portion of the UI has been modified.2: Edits have been made in the ruler area of the UI.

messages.name: active
messages.digest: Deactivate/activate all sequences
messages.description: If theattribute is set to zero, the messagedeactivates all sequences. The word, followed by any non-zero value, will activate all sequences.If theattribute is set to a value greater than zero, the messagedeactivates the specified sequence. The word, followed by any non-zero value, will activate the specified sequence.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Report values for all sequences
messages.description: If theattribute is set to zero, amessage will send the values associated with the current step of all sequences out the object's left outlet. If theattribute is set to a value greater than zero, amessage will send the values associated with the current step of the currently specified sequence out the object's left outlet.

messages.name: copy
messages.digest: Copy all or a part of a sequence
messages.description: The wordwill copy the entire sequence. One or two optional integer arguments may be used to specify starting and ending indices (index numbering starts at 1). For example,will copy the sequence starting at index 2, whilewill copy starting at index 2 and ending at index 5.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.digest: Set sequences with a dictionary
messages.description: Replaces the current sequence or all sequences of live.step by the content of a named dictionary. If multiple sequences are present in the dictionary, every sequences is replaced.

messages.name: direction
messages.digest: Set the playback direction for sequences
messages.description: The wordfollowed by an integer in the range 0-4, sets the playback direction for sequence playback. The playback options are:: forward: backward: back and forth: Rotate: randomIf theattribute is set to zero, the integer argument sets the direction of all sequences whenobject's playback is controlled using themessage.If theattribute is set to a value greater than zero, an integer sets the direction of the specified sequence whenobject's playback is controlled using themessage.

messages.name: doedit
messages.digest: Move or rotate stored sequence data
messages.description: The word, followed by a number in the range 0-4, provides a simple means to move or rotate the parameters stored in theobject. The modes specified by the number arguments are:: transpose the pitch upward.: transpose the pitch downward.: Rotate the steps to the left.: Rotate the steps to the right: Randomize steps depending on theattribute. For instance, if theis set to velocity,4 will only randomize the velocity.For more advanced editing features, use the,,,,,, andmessages.

messages.name: down
messages.digest: Decreases the values of a sequence based onandattributes
messages.description: The wordwill decreases the values of the sequence based on theandattributes. For instance, if theattribute is set to velocity, themessage will only decrease the velocity of the currently specified sequence (or all the sequences if theattribute is set to zero).An optional argument may be used with themessage to specify the parameters to be decreased without having to use theattribute. The optional arguments are:: decrease all parameters: transpose pitches downward: decrease velocities: decrease durations: decrease values for the user-definable Extra 1 parameter: decrease values for the user-definable Extra 2 parameter

messages.name: dump
messages.digest: Report all sequence values
messages.description: Sends the values (pitch, velocity, duration, extra1, extra2) of all steps of the currently specified sequence out theobject's right outlet.

messages.name: dump_to_dict
messages.digest: Report sequences in dictionary format
messages.description: Sends out a dictionary of the current sequence or all sequences (if target_seq is set to 0), via the dump outlet.

messages.name: duration
messages.digest: Set duration values for the current sequence
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer that specifies a starting index into a sequence (index numbering starts with 1) and a list of values (in ticks), will set the duration values for the current sequence specified by theattribute.

messages.name: extra1
messages.digest: Set extra1 values for the current sequence
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer that specifies a starting index into a sequence (index numbering starts with 1) and a list of values, will set the extra1 values for the current sequence specified by theattribute.

messages.name: extra2
messages.digest: Set extra2 values for the current sequence
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer that specifies a starting index into a sequence (index numbering starts with 1) and a list of values, will set the extra2 values for the current sequence specified by theattribute.

messages.name: fetch
messages.digest: Report parameter values for a step in the sequence
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol that specifies a step parameter (pitch, velocity, duration, extra1, or extra2) and an integer that specifies a step number, will send a list out of theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form.

messages.name: fold
messages.digest: Toggle folded display mode
messages.description: The word, followed by a 0 or 1, toggles the folded display mode. When folding is enabled, theobject only displays those pitches which are present in the sequence specified by theattribute rather than all possible pitches. Fold mode displays only the pitches specific to.Note: Sequence editing messages such as,, anduse the list of pitches displayed in fold state when performing operations (i.e., themessage will only choose randomly from among the pitches displayed on fold mode. These operations are also dependent on the target sequence, as well). for all sequences.

messages.name: fold_pitch
messages.digest: Set pitches to be displayed in fold mode
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer or list of integers that specify MIDI note numbers, sets the pitches to be displayed by theobject in fold mode. As with themessage, themessage sets pitches to be displayed in the sequence specified by theattribute.

messages.name: getactive
messages.digest: Report the active state of the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send the active state of the currently specified sequence out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getcurrentstep
messages.digest: Report the current step of the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send the current step of the sequence out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a number preceded by the word. When working with multiple sequences, themessage will report the current step of the targeted sequence (specified by theattribute).

messages.name: getdirection
messages.digest: Report the direction state of the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send the direction state of the currently specified sequence out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getduration
messages.digest: Report all duration values in the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send a list of all the duration values in the sequence specified by theattribute out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getextra1
messages.digest: Report all extra1 values in the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send a list of all the extra1 values in the sequence specified by theattribute out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getextra2
messages.digest: Report all extra2 values in the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send a list of all the extra2 values in the sequence specified by theattribute out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getinterval
messages.digest: Report the interval of the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send the interval of the currently specified sequence out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getloop
messages.digest: Report the loop points in the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send the loop points of the currently specified sequence out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getmodelist
messages.digest: Report all display modes
messages.description: The messagewill send the list of the display modes out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getnstep
messages.digest: Report the number of steps in the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send the number of steps in the currently specified sequence out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getpitch
messages.digest: Report all pitch values in the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send a list of all the pitch values in the sequence specified by theattribute out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getstep
messages.digest: Report all parameter values for a sequence step
messages.description: The messagewill send a list of the values (pitch, velocity, duration, extra1, extra2) of the specified index of the currently specified sequence out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getvelocity
messages.digest: Report all velocity values in the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send a list of all the velocity values in the sequence specified by theattribute out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: getzoom
messages.digest: Report the zoom pitch values of the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The messagewill send the zoom pitch values of the currently specified sequence out theobject's fourth (dumpout) outlet in the form of a list preceded by the word.

messages.name: init
messages.digest: Restore and output the initial values entered when Initial Enabled is checked in theobject's Inspector
messages.description: Restores and outputs the initial values entered when Initial Enabled is checked in theobject's Inspector.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Set the current step for all sequences
messages.description: If theattribute is set to zero, an integer sets the current step of all sequences to the corresponding integer (index numbering starts at 1). If theattribute is set to a value greater than zero, an integer sets the current step of the currently specified sequence. The values associated with the current step are sent out the object's left outlet.

messages.name: interval
messages.digest: Set the interval of the currently specified sequence
messages.description: Sets the interval of the currently specified sequence.

messages.name: left
messages.digest: Left-shift the sequence values based on theandattributes
messages.description: The wordwill rotate (left-shift) the values of the sequence based on theandattributes. For instance, if theattribute is set to velocity, themessage will only rotate the velocity of the currently specified sequence (or all the sequences if theattribute is set to zero).An optional argument may be used with themessage to specify the parameters to be rotated without having to use theattribute. The optional arguments are:: Rotate all parameters to the left: Rotate all pitches to the left: Rotate all velocities to the left: Rotate all durations to the left: Rotate all user-definable Extra 1 parameters to the left: Rotate all user-definable Extra 2 parameters to the left

messages.name: loop
messages.digest: Set loop points for the currently specified sequence
messages.description: The word, followed by two numbers that specify starting and ending indices, sets the loop points of the currently specified sequence.

messages.name: next
messages.digest: Report the values for the next step in the sequences
messages.description: Themessage will send the values associated with the next step of all sequences out the object's left outlet. If theattribute is set to a value greater than zero, amessage will send the values associated with the next step of the currently specified sequence out the object's left outlet.

messages.name: nstep
messages.digest: Set the number of steps in the target sequence
messages.description: Sets the number of steps in the target sequence.

messages.name: paste
messages.digest: Paste steps into a sequence
messages.description: When themessage is received without argument, all parameters are pasted at the same location as they were copied. An optional argument to specify parameter type (pitch, velocity, duration, extra1, extra2) can be used to paste only specific items. An additional option number argument specifies the starting index where the copied steps will be pasted (index numbering starts at 1).

messages.name: pitch
messages.digest: Set pitch values for the current sequence
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer that specifies a starting index into a sequence (index numbering starts with 1) and a list of values, will set the pitch values for the current sequence specified by theattribute.

messages.name: random
messages.digest: Randomize values in the seqence
messages.description: The wordwill randomize the values of the sequence based on theandattributes. For instance, if theattribute is set to velocity, themessage will only scramble the velocity of the currently specified sequence (or all the sequences if theattribute is set to zero).An optional argument may be used with themessage to specify the parameters to be scrambled without having to use theattribute. The optional arguments are:: Randomize all parameters: Randomize all pitches: Randomize all velocities: Randomize all durations: Randomize all values for the user-definable Extra 1 parameter: Randomize all values for the user-definable Extra 2 parameter

messages.name: reset
messages.digest: Deactivate the current step
messages.description: Themessage allows you to deactivate the current step. It is equivalent to setting the current step to 0.

messages.name: right
messages.digest: Right-shift the sequence values based on theandattributes
messages.description: The wordwill rotate (right-shift) the values of the sequence based on theandattributes. For instance, if theattribute is set to velocity, themessage will only rotate the velocity of the currently specified sequence (or all the sequences if theattribute is set to zero).An optional argument may be used with themessage to specify the parameters to be rotated without having to use theattribute. The optional arguments are:: Rotate all parameters to the right: Rotate all pitches to the right: Rotate all velocities to the right: Rotate all durations to the right: Rotate all values for the user-definable Extra 1 parameter to the right: Rotate all values for the user-definable Extra 2 parameter to the right

messages.name: scramble
messages.digest: Randomize the order of sequence values based onandattributes
messages.description: The wordwill randomize the order of the values of the sequence based on theandattributes. For instance, if theattribute is set to velocity, themessage will only scramble the velocity of the currently specified sequence (or all the sequences if theattribute is set to zero).An optional argument may be used with themessage to specify the parameters to be scrambled without having to use theattribute. The optional arguments are:: Randomize the order of all parameters: Randomize the order of all pitches: Randomize the order of all velocities: Randomize the order of all durations: Randomize the order of all user-definable Extra 1 parameters: Randomize the order of all user-definable Extra 2 parametersIf you are not usingall, and that you passas argument,will keep your steps synchronized. For instance, themessage will reorder the pitches, but the other parameters will follow.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the current step of all the sequences
messages.description: If theattribute is set to zero, the word, followed by an integer sets the current step of all the sequences to the corresponding integer (index numbering starts at 1).If theattribute is set to a value greater than zero, the word, followed by an integer sets the current step of the currently specified sequence.

messages.name: setall
messages.digest: Set a value for all layers in the current sequence
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, will assign that value to every layer in the currently targeted sequence when the theobject is in display mode. An optional first argument specifying a specific layer (i.e.) can be used to set all values in a specify layer. When theattribute is set to 1, themessage will only be applied to indices inside the loop selection.

messages.name: settimeshift
messages.digest: Move to a sequence step relative to the current step
messages.description: The word, followed by a positive or negative number that specifies an offset, will move to the relative position from the current step in the sequence and first that step (e.g., sending the messagewhen the current step number is 3 will cause the content of step 2 to fire.

messages.name: sort
messages.digest: Sort step values of a sequence based on theandattributes
messages.description: The wordwill sort the step values of the sequence based on theandattributes. For instance, if theattribute is set to velocity, themessage will only sort the velocity values of the currently specified sequence (or all the sequences if theattribute is set to zero).Optional arguments may be used with themessage to specify behavior, synchronization, and direction of sortint. The can be used to set the parameters to be sorted without having to use theattribute. The optional arguments are:: Sort the order of all parameters: Sort the order of the pitches: Sort the order of the velocities: Sort the order of the durations: Sort the order of all user-definable Extra 1 parameters: Sort the order of all user-definable Extra 2 parametersThe first integer argument specifies whether or not to keep the step values synchronized - it only works if theattribute is not set to. For instance, the messagewill reorder the steps based on the pitch, but the velocity, duration and user-definable extra1 and extra2 values associated to the pitch will be maintained. An optional second integer argument can be used to set the sorting order:: Ascending (the default): Descending.

messages.name: step
messages.digest: Set the values for a sequence step
messages.description: The word, followed by a list of four integers, sets the values of a specific step. The required arguments are:the index (index numbering starts at 1)the MIDI note number (0-127)the note velocity (0-127)the duration (30, 60, 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920, 3840 ticks)

messages.name: time
messages.digest: Specify the timing position in the sequence.
messages.description: The word, followed by a list of 6 numbers, defines the timing position in the sequence. The required arguments are,,,,, and. Theobject does not have an internal, so you need to send the time message often if you want to use it to drive theobject.
messages.argPattern: bar:int, beat:int, unit:int, resolution:int, time-sig-numerator:list, time-sig-denominator:list

messages.name: up
messages.digest: Increase values of the sequence based on theandattributes
messages.description: The wordwill increase the values of the sequence based on theandattributes. For instance, if theattribute is set to velocity, themessage will only increase the velocity of the currently specified sequence (or all the sequences if theattribute is set to zero).An optional argument may be used with themessage to specify the parameters to be increased without having to use theattribute. The optional arguments are:: Increase all parameters: Transpose pitches upward: Increase velocities: Increase durations: Increase the value of all user-definable Extra 1 parameters: Increase the value of all user-definable Extra 2 parameters

messages.name: velocity
messages.digest: Set velocity values for the current sequence
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer that specifies a starting index into a sequence (index numbering starts with 1) and a list of values, will set the velocity values for the current sequence specified by theattribute.

messages.name: zoom
messages.digest: Sets the the upper and lower displayed range of the currently specified sequence
messages.description: Sets the the upper and lower displayed range of the currently specified sequence.

messages.name: zoom_fit
messages.digest: Set the pitch display ranges based on low/high note values
messages.description: The wordwill cause the currently displayed pitch range of theobject to adjust so that the highest and lowest note values become the upper and lower limits of the display.

messages.name: zoom_in
messages.digest: Decrease the displayed pitch range by 7 steps
messages.description: The wordwill cause the current pitch range of theobject display to decrease by a factor of a fifth (7 steps) at the top and bottom, resulting in a "zoom in" effect.

messages.name: zoom_out
messages.digest: Increase the displayed pitch range by 7 steps
messages.description: The wordwill cause the current pitch range of theobject display to increase by a factor of a fifth (7 steps) at the top and bottom, resulting in a "zoom out" effect.

outlets.digest: Step Values (Index Pitch, Velocity, Duration, Extra1, Extra2)
